dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT social_id, social_name, url, implementation_id FROM tp_social_settings
INSERT INTO tp_social_settings (social_id,social_name, url, implementation_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE social_name= VALUES(social_name), url= VALUES(url)

SELECT social_id, social_name, url, api_type, tsai.implementation_id FROM tp_social_settings tss LEFT JOIN tp_social_api_implementation tsai ON tss.implementation_id = tsai.implementation_id LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON tsai.source_id = ts.source_id

SELECT ts.source_id,social_id, social_name, url, api_type, tsai.implementation_id FROM tp_social_settings tss LEFT JOIN tp_social_api_implementation tsai ON tss.implementation_id = tsai.implementation_id LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON tsai.source_id = ts.source_id where ts.source_id IN (@@)

SELECT social_id, social_name, url, api_type, tsai.implementation_id FROM tp_social_settings tss LEFT JOIN tp_social_api_implementation tsai ON tss.implementation_id = tsai.implementation_id LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON tsai.source_id = ts.source_id WHERE tss.socialId = ?
INSERT INTO tp_user_oauthtoken (userid,oauth_token,source_id) VALUES (?,?,?) ON duplicate KEY UPDATE oauth_token= VALUES(oauth_token)
SELECT source_id,oauth_token FROM tp_user_oauthtoken WHERE userid=? and oauth_token <> ''
SELECT implementation_id, api_type , source_id FROM tp_social_api_implementation
DELETE FROM tp_social_settings WHERE social_id = ? AND implementation_id= ?
SELECT cast(group_concat(source_id) as char) as socialWithToken FROM tp_user_oauthtoken WHERE userid=? and oauth_token <> ''
SELECT cast(group_concat(user_id) as char) as socialWithToken FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map WHERE user_id=? and graph_status = ?
INSERT INTO tp_applicant_user_person_map (applicant_id,user_id,graph_status) VALUES (?,?,?);

SELECT DISTINCT taupm.person_id AS personId, ta.applicant_id AS applicantId, ta.applicant_name AS applicantName, cast(group_concat(ti.institute_name separator '|') AS char) AS institute , cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN taei.educational_info_year_of_passing IS NOT NULL THEN taei.educational_info_year_of_passing ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS year_of_passing, cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN tb.branch_name IS NOT NULL THEN tb.branch_name ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS specialization, cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN td.degree_title IS NOT NULL THEN td.degree_title ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS degree, ta.applicant_city AS location FROM tp_applicant_educational_info taei LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON ta.applicant_id = taei.applicant_id LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm ON taupm.applicant_id = taei.applicant_id LEFT JOIN tp_institutes ti ON ti.institute_id = taei.institute_id LEFT JOIN tp_degrees td ON td.degree_id = taei.degree_id LEFT JOIN tp_branches tb ON tb.branch_id = taei.branch_id WHERE taupm.graph_status = '0' AND (taupm.user_id IS NULL OR taupm.user_id = '') AND (ti.institute_name <>'' OR ti.institute_name IS NOT NULL) AND taupm.person_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ta.applicant_id

SELECT DISTINCT taupm.person_id AS personId, ta.applicant_id AS applicantId, ta.applicant_name AS applicantName, ta.applicant_city AS location, cast(group_concat(te.employer_name separator '|') AS char) AS employer , cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN tds.designation_name IS NOT NULL THEN tds.designation_name ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS designation, cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN taeh.employmer_from_date IS NOT NULL THEN taeh.employmer_from_date ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS employerFromDate, cast(group_concat(CASE WHEN taeh.employmer_to_date IS NOT NULL THEN taeh.employmer_to_date ELSE ' ' END separator '|') AS char) AS employerToDate FROM tp_applicant_employment_history taeh LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON ta.applicant_id = taeh.applicant_id LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm ON taupm.applicant_id = taeh.applicant_id LEFT JOIN tp_employers te ON te.employer_id = taeh.employer_id LEFT JOIN tp_designations tds ON tds.designation_id = taeh.designation_id WHERE taupm.graph_status = '0' AND (taupm.user_id IS NULL OR taupm.user_id = '') AND (te.employer_name <> '' OR te.employer_name IS NOT NULL) AND taupm.person_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ta.applicant_id
update tp_applicant_user_person_map set graph_status = ? where person_id in (@@);
INSERT INTO tp_uuid_oauth_map (uuid, oauth_token, source_id, date_created) VALUES (?, ?, ?, now())

SELECT taupm.person_id, tao.oauth_token, ts.source_title FROM tp_applicant_oauthtoken tao, tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm,tp_sources ts WHERE tao.applicant_id=taupm.applicant_id AND tao.source_id=ts.source_id AND tao.applicant_id IN (@@)
INSERT INTO tp_applicant_user_person_map (user_id,graph_status) VALUES (?,?) on duplicate key update user_id = values(user_id), graph_status = values(graph_status);
SELECT person_id FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map WHERE user_id = ?;
SELECT person_id FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map WHERE user_id = ? AND graph_status = ?;

SELECT CAST(group_concat(f) AS char) FROM ( SELECT ta.applicant_name AS f FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm JOIN tp_applicant_joining_history tajh ON taupm.applicant_id = tajh.applicant_id JOIN tp_applicants ta ON ta.applicant_id=taupm.applicant_id WHERE taupm.person_id in (@@) UNION SELECT tu.user_name AS f FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm JOIN tp_users tu ON taupm.user_id=tu.user_id WHERE taupm.person_id IN (@@) ) AS t
DELETE FROM tp_user_oauthtoken WHERE userid=? AND source_id=?

INSERT INTO tp_social_credentials (client_id,client_secret,source_id,company_id) VALUES (?,?,(SELECT source_id FROM tp_sources WHERE source_title = ?),?) ON duplicate KEY UPDATE client_id= VALUES(client_id),client_secret = VALUES (client_secret),company_id= VALUES (company_id)
SELECT client_id,client_secret,source_title,company_id FROM tp_social_credentials tsc ,tp_sources ts WHERE tsc.source_id = ts.source_id;

SELECT taupm.person_id,tao.oauth_token,ts.source_title,taupm.graph_status FROM tp_applicant_user_person_map taupm LEFT JOIN tp_applicant_oauthtoken tao ON taupm.applicant_id = tao.applicant_id LEFT JOIN tp_sources ts ON tao.source_id = ts.source_id WHERE taupm.applicant_id = ?;
